description: The CAREGIVERS table contains information about caregivers, including a unique identifier (CGID), a descriptive label, and a more detailed description. Each row is uniquely identified by ROW_ID. The table likely serves as a reference table for categorizing and describing different types or aspects of caregivers within a clinical context.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: CGID
columns.description: Identifier for the caregiver group, referencing a related table (e.g., CARE_GROUP_TABLE).

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Category or type assigned to the caregiver, providing a classification for different caregiver roles or specializations.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: A free text field providing a description of the concept or term.
